description: Interactive change graph for Git commits inside Herdr: fast static analysis for C#/.NET, TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL/Prisma, optional AI semantic enrichment with disk cache, orthogonal ELK layout, semantic zoom, relationship filters and inline diffs.

settings.label: AI program
settings.hint: The program used when you click Enrich with AI. Auto picks Claude Code if installed, else Codex. Runs read-only on the repository's machine.

settings.label: AI model
settings.hint: Empty: sonnet for Claude Code, default model for Codex.

settings.label: Overview threshold
settings.hint: Selections with more changed files than this open in Overview mode automatically so large graphs stay readable.

settings.label: Fullscreen dialog
settings.hint: Open the modal dialog sized to the full Herdr window instead of a compact box.

settings.label: AI analysis cache
settings.hint: Purge all cached AI design models stored on disk under ~/.config/herdr-app/data/visual-review/cache.
